verdict.rationale: Intuit ships an official QuickBooks Online MCP server with full CRUD across 29 entity types, plus V3 REST SDKs, write-safety toggles, and a sandbox. That makes it plausible for an agent to create ledger transactions via the API, and accountants can be given direct access to the books. However, nothing in the pack shows that journal entries are among the supported entities, or that a draft or pending-review queue exists where agent-posted entries wait for accountant approval; the only related item is a generic mention of custom workflows. Missing for 10: explicit JournalEntry API coverage, a draft/unposted state or review queue for agent-created entries, an accountant approval workflow tied to API-created transactions, hands-on corroboration.
